    ॐAbout the library

    Bharat knew. Let us remember.

    Library of Sanatana Dharma exists to bring the ancient scriptures of Bharat into everyday life: in your language, in your home, and in the way you handle each day.

    THENA civilisation far ahead

    What ancient Bharat already knew

    ✦

    Long before the modern world gave these ideas new names, the thinkers of Bharat were measuring, healing, building and questioning. These are only some of the examples, each with an episode where you can go deeper.

    THEN → NOWHow it was set aside

    The knowledge did not vanish. It was sidelined.

    ✦

    The texts survived because families, teachers and temples kept memorising and copying them. But under colonial rule the systems that taught and supported them lost their place, and over time many of us learned to see our own heritage as old-fashioned. The story, in short:

    NOWA roadmap for life

    Every part of life already has a path

    ✦

    Sanatana Dharma is not only worship. It is a practical guide to living: for the body, the mind, the family, work, society, nature and purpose. Pick the part of life you are thinking about, and begin there.

    OUR WAYHow we work

    Simple, honest and in your language

    ✦
    🪷 Original first

    Every card and book starts with the Sanskrit from the source text, with its reference, so you can check it.

    🪔 Three languages

    English, Hindi and Kannada meanings side by side. Wisdom should not need a translator.

    🛕 For daily life

    Cards by mood and by hour, books by emotion. Something small you can carry into the day.

    JYOTISHYA · ज्योतिष

    Janma Kundali & Dasha

    Enter your birth details to generate your Vedic birth chart, Navagraha positions, house lords, planetary aspects, and Vimshottari Dasha timeline — all calculated using Lahiri ayanamsa and the whole-sign house system.

    🪐 Birth Details

    📜 What is Jyotishya?

    Jyotishya (ज्योतिष) is one of the six Vedangas — the limbs of the Vedas — described as "the eye of the Vedas" (vedānāṃ cakṣuḥ). It is the ancient Indian science of time, planetary cycles and their relationship to human life.

    The Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra, Brihat Jataka (Varahamihira), Saravali and other classical texts form the core of Jyotisha. The system uses the sidereal zodiac (Nirayana), corrected from the tropical zodiac using the ayanamsa — the measure of the precession of the equinoxes.

    Disclaimer: This tool is for educational and cultural interest. It is not a substitute for professional guidance in health, legal or financial decisions. All calculations are approximate and clearly labelled as a prototype.

    Gift wisdom

    Give a verse that was heard, not made

    No human wrote the first shlokas. Tradition holds that the rishis, the seers, heard them from the cosmos in the depth of meditation. This is why the Vedas are called Shruti, “that which is heard”. A book or a wall frame of these verses carries something older than any one person. It is a gift of calm, courage and clarity for someone you love.

    Give to a school or temple

    Sponsor books for a school, library or temple, so the tradition reaches young readers and families who cannot afford it.
